summary: The five requested audio test files pass. The map replacement path can still play a stale file after its event mapping changes.
nonblocking_findings: F4 [Major] review-c: src/apk3d/audio/bus.ts:119-124,282-294 clears the loading marker when an event mapping changes, but an older request can still install its decoded buffer when that event remains mapped. tests/apk3d/audio-files.adversarial.test.ts expects the old file to play after changing correct from right to wrong, so callers hear stale audio instead of the newly mapped file. Bind the request to its mapping and reject stale completion.
